prompt_template: IDENTITY-PRESERVE sprite frame. Image 1 is the locked Warrior identity; Image 2 is the exact pose guide. Produce one full-body 2D pixel-art RPG battle sprite on flat #00ff00. Preserve the enclosed silver plate helmet and black visor, gold trim, blue plume/scarf/cape, armor proportions and palette. Match the guide's silhouette, limb positions and planted feet. BODY ONLY: no weapon, shield, magic, text, UI, shadow or scenery. Crisp hard pixel clusters, no antialiasing, centered with generous clear margin, 1:1.
frame_prompts: Guard: grounded ready stance facing screen-left; left weapon hand extended and empty.
Anticipate: weight shifts back; empty weapon hand draws behind the body.
Raise: both gauntlets overhead around an invisible sword grip.
Impact: decisive screen-left lunge; empty weapon hand reaches the contact point.
Follow-through: low screen-left sweep recovery with readable balance.
Recover: return toward the original guarded silhouette.
weapon_prompt_template: STYLIZED-CONCEPT asset. One isolated vertical pixel-art sword matching the Warrior sprite's scale and palette on flat #00ff00. Tip up, grip down, centered, no hand, character, shadow, text, UI or scenery; crisp hard pixel clusters, 1:1.
